# HappyMom

HappyMom is a Korean-English in-home postpartum care service for mothers and newborns in Los Angeles, Orange County, California, and across the United States.

Website: https://happymom7080.com
Korean website: https://happymom7080.com
English website: https://happymom7080.com/en
Phone: +1 (213) 999-4642
Email: happymom7080@gmail.com
KakaoTalk: Happy-mom

## Services

- Live-in postpartum care
- Commuting postpartum care
- Newborn care
- Maternal recovery support
- Feeding support
- Meal preparation and light home support
- Babysitting

## Pricing

Pricing is published on the pricing page and may vary by service type, care period, family needs, twins, travel distance, and schedule.

Key pricing page: https://happymom7080.com/pricing
English pricing page: https://happymom7080.com/en/pricing

## Service Areas

HappyMom serves Los Angeles, Orange County, Irvine, Koreatown, California, and other United States regions by consultation and caregiver availability.

## Important Disclaimer

HappyMom is not a medical institution and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, prescription, or emergency medical services. Mothers and families should contact a qualified medical professional or emergency service for medical concerns.
